selected_script.angle: Absurd grandfather chef rescues family bathroom from wet hair clogs using grey silicone catcher
selected_script.hook: Water pooling around a messy hair clog in the shower drain

usage_steps_used: Clean and wipe dry the area around the drain opening
Place the Hair Catcher directly over the drain opening
Press down firmly on the corner suction cups
Use shower as usual and lift/remove caught hair from the dome as needed

script_record.pain_point: Water pooling and clogging standard shower drains due to loose hair
script_record.conflict_hook: Gross hair clog blocking water flow in a bathroom drain
script_record.product_solution: Kitsch silicone hair catcher placed over the smooth drain opening with suction cups pressed down

timeline.scene: Close-up of a hand wiping dry the area around a clogged shower drain, showing pooling water and hair debris.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An absurd grandfather wearing a chef hat and apron enters holding the grey kitsch hair catcher, placing it flat over the drain, saying 'No more clogs!'
Close-up of fingers pressing down firmly on all four corner suction cups against the smooth tile surface around the drain opening.
Water flows through the perforated dome grid while hair is captured on the outer silicone surface.
Fast cut of the grey silicone catcher placed over a smooth flat bathtub drain surface.
A hand lifts and manually removes caught hair from the top mesh surface of the dome after a shower.
Clean background display with text overlay: 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.'

script_record.cta: Make your space cleaner and cozier.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-1.5s: Close-up of a hand wiping dry the smooth surface around a clogged shower drain with pooling water. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity: 6x6 inch grey silicone catcher with a raised perforated dome center, outer radial slot vents, and circular suction cups on the bottom corners. Do not change color, shape, or material. Do not use on highly textured or porous tile surfaces.
